podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Rebranding (2021)
podcast.body: In 2021, Levi rebranded from performing under the name Mutley to using his own name, also adopting a new musical style. "In 2021, though, he rebranded under his own name and with a change in style."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Musical Learning
podcast.body: For a significant period, Levi avoided the spotlight but learned to play both guitar and piano from his father. "For the longest time, Levi stayed away from the spotlight, although he learned guitar and piano from his dad."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Instagram Sharing
podcast.body: Initially, he shared his musical content on Instagram. "For a while, he was happy to post a stuff on Instagram."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of The Edge and Morleigh Steinberg
podcast.body: Levi Evans is the only son of Dave "The Edge" Evans and Morleigh Steinberg, who was known as the "Mysterious Ways" dancer during U2's Zoo TV tour. He has an older sister named Sean and three stepsisters. "Levi is the edges only son. He has an older sister named Sean and three step sisters from the Edge's first marriage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
